subject: NUMVAL function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-09 (PB60): the two 15.67.3 r1 formats are ALTERNATIVES in the one scan - a leading sign consumes format A, after which a trailing sign/CR/DB is an ERROR POSITION, never a toggle. "-12-" (conforming to neither format) now raises EC (default 0, golden row MM; TEST-NUMVAL position 4, row TM) where the old double-strip toggled it to POSITIVE 12. On the conforming forms r2's containment reading holds by construction: "12.5-" and "12.5CR" value -12.5 (rows TS/CV).
